title: manni graph golden-set file
description: A list of reader questions that span pages or that the docs don't answer (proposal 0087). Each item is a page sample question's object form, plus `answers[].file` and `language`. `graph.questionFiles` names the files, and `manni graph check` asks their questions.

question.description: The question, as a reader would ask it.

file.description: The page that holds this answer, relative to the config file.

lines.description: Body lines of that page, counted as for a citation's claim.

integrity.description: The pin over those lines, under cite's hashing rule. Without it, the lines are not checked for change.

reviewed.description: `false` marks a pin nobody has confirmed. Absent means `true`.

answers.description: The lines that answer the question, on one page or several. An empty list marks a known gap: a question the docs don't answer.

language.description: The question's language, as a BCP-47 tag. Absent, it is the first answer's page language.

generated-by.description: The model that drafted the question or any of its pins, as `provider/model`.

reviewed.description: `false` marks a drafted question, and its pins are drafts with it. Absent means `true`.

reviewed-by.description: Who confirmed the question. An optional record.
